name: 你装纨绔，我装瞎，看谁能演
original_name: 你装纨绔，我装瞎，看谁能演
overview: A blind noblewoman, Xie Chengjun, uses her sharp mind to survive the dangers of her marquis household, breaking an unwanted engagement and outmaneuvering her scheming relatives. She unexpectedly allies with the Sixth Prince, Lu Yunque, a notorious playboy who hides a calculating mind and unwavering loyalty.
